focus_areas: Text legibility and authenticity in speech bubbles/captions (Primary Focus)
Structural integrity of panel layouts and borders
Consistency of artistic style and print-like texture
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text within the speech bubbles and caption boxes. AI generators often struggle with rendering coherent text, resulting in gibberish or malformed characters. Verify if the text is readable English (or another language) or if it is nonsensical symbols. Also, examine the edges of the panels for any warping or inconsistency that might indicate generative artifacts rather than intentional artistic style. Specifically check for the absence of large 'Cover' style titles to confirm this is an interior page.
image_description: The image displays a single interior page from a comic book, featuring a complex grid layout of multiple panels. The artwork style is gritty and illustrative, depicting various characters in action poses, including a figure in green armor holding a weapon, and other abstract or monstrous figures. The page contains speech bubbles and caption boxes with text. The paper appears aged or textured, consistent with printed media.
